name: Duo Security - Administrator Events
description: See geo - location of admin events, one day time comparison of events,  login errors, admin activity over time, and events breakdown by action
title: Duo Security - Administrator Events

queries.queryString:
_sourceCategory={{Logsdatasource}}  administrator  "admin_login_error"
| json field=_raw "eventtype" as eventtype nodrop   
| where eventtype = "administrator" 
| json field=_raw "action" as action nodrop
| where action = "admin_login_error"
| json field=_raw "timestamp" as time nodrop
| time* 1000 as timemilli
| formatDate(fromMillis(toLong(timemilli)), "MM-dd-yyyy HH:mm:ss") as date_time
| json field=_raw "username" as user_name nodrop
| json field=_raw "description" as description nodrop
| json field=description "error" as error nodrop
| json field=description "email" as email nodrop
| json field=description "ip_address" as ip_address nodrop
|where if ("{{description}}" = "*", true, description matches "{{description}}") AND if ("{{user_name}}" = "*", true, user_name matches "{{user_name}}") AND if ("{{action}}" = "*", true, action matches "{{action}}")
|count by user_name, date_time, error, ip_address
| sort by date_time asc

_sourceCategory={{Logsdatasource}}  administrator  
| json field=_raw "eventtype" as eventtype   
| where eventtype = "administrator" 
| json field=_raw "object" as object 
| json field=_raw "timestamp" as time
| time* 1000 as timemilli
| formatDate(fromMillis(toLong(timemilli)), "MM-dd-yyyy HH:mm:ss") as date_time
| json field=_raw "username" as user_name
| json field=_raw "description" as description
| json field=_raw "action" as action
|where if ("{{description}}" = "*", true, description matches "{{description}}") AND if ("{{user_name}}" = "*", true, user_name matches "{{user_name}}") AND if ("{{action}}" = "*", true, action matches "{{action}}") AND if ("{{object}}" = "*", true, object matches "{{object}}")
|count by action, user_name, date_time, object
| sort by date_time asc

queries.queryString:
_sourceCategory={{Logsdatasource}}  administrator  "admin_login_error"
| json field=_raw "object" as object nodrop
| json field=_raw "eventtype" as eventtype nodrop  
| where eventtype = "administrator" 
| json field=_raw "action" as action nodrop
| where action = "admin_login_error"
| json field=_raw "timestamp" as time nodrop
| time* 1000 as timemilli
| formatDate(fromMillis(toLong(timemilli)), "MM-dd-yyyy HH:mm:ss") as date_time
| json field=_raw "username" as user_name nodrop
| json field=_raw "description" as description nodrop
| json field=description "error" as error nodrop
| json field=description "email" as email nodrop
| json field=description "ip_address" as ip_address nodrop
| lookup latitude, longitude, country_code, country_name, region, city, postal_code from geo://location on ip = ip_address
|where if ("{{description}}" = "*", true, description matches "{{description}}") AND if ("{{user_name}}" = "*", true, user_name matches "{{user_name}}") AND if ("{{action}}" = "*", true, action matches "{{action}}") AND if ("{{object}}" = "*", true, object matches "{{object}}")
|count by latitude, longitude, country_code, country_name, region, city, postal_code
| sort _count

|count by _timeslice, action 
| transpose row _timeslice column action
| fillmissing timeslice(1h)
